findings.title: Missing empty-type guard before double-field store in TryBuildStoreField
findings.message: In `TryBuildStoreField`, when the field representation is double and the access has a transition map, the code calls `GetAccumulator()` to obtain `float64_value` without first checking whether the accumulator's node type is empty (which signals unreachable/dead code in the Maglev type system). The empty-typed value is then wrapped in a `Float64ToHeapNumberForField` node and passed to `BuildStoreTaggedField`. Inside `BuildStoreTaggedField`, `CanElideWriteBarrier` is called on the resulting tagged heap-number node. Because the write-barrier logic cannot consistently determine whether a barrier is needed for a value derived from dead-code (empty-type) operands, a DCHECK failure is triggered. The type system refactoring (commit 7556d7f) changed `NodeTypeIs` semantics so that the empty type is a mathematical subset of every type (via bit-mask arithmetic), enabling values with empty types to propagate silently through type checks that previously rejected them. A partial fix (commit 6953465) guarded `CanElideWriteBarrier` itself but left a TODO acknowledging that `TryBuildStoreField` still needed an early bailout for empty-typed values.
findings.suggestion: Before entering the double-field handling block (and indeed before all type-specific checks in TryBuildStoreField), retrieve the accumulator value once and immediately bail out with an unconditional deopt when its node type is empty. This matches the fix applied in the fix commit: move `value = GetAccumulator()` to before the double block and insert `if (IsEmptyNodeType(GetType(value))) return EmitUnconditionalDeopt(DeoptimizeReason::kWrongValue);`.

ground_truth.root_cause: The Maglev type-system refactoring (commit 7556d7f) introduced empty node types as a sentinel for dead/unreachable code and changed `NodeTypeIs` so that the empty type is a subset of every type (0 & ~X == 0 for all X). This means empty-typed values pass type-compatibility tests silently. `TryBuildStoreField` lacked an early exit for empty-typed accumulator values, so the double-field code path could proceed with a logically impossible value and produce type contradictions in downstream write-barrier analysis.
